headline: Activists Turn Facial Recognition Tools Against the Police
snippet: “We’re now approaching the technological threshold where the little guys can do it to the big guys,” one researcher said.

headline: Lesson of the Day: ‘Seeing Our Own Reflection in the Birth of the Self-Portrait’
snippet: In this lesson, students will learn about Albrecht Dürer’s masterpiece and the development of the self as a unique individual, worthy of depiction. Then students will create self-portraits and consider what it reveals about who they really are.

headline: Big Tech’s Professional Opponents Strike at Google
snippet: An unlikely collection of lawyers, activists, economists and academics is fueling the tech backlash, armed with funding from billionaire sponsors.

headline: Does Palantir See Too Much?
snippet: The tech giant helps governments and law enforcement decipher vast amounts of data — to mysterious and, some say, dangerous ends.

headline: Review: ‘Futurity,’ in a Civil War Setting, Wishes for Today’s Technology
snippet: This odd and often beguiling show written by César Alvarez with his band the Lisps is a show made for brainiacs.
